primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Subjects completed a 3-component VAS on a 100 mm scale for severity of abdominal pain, skin pain and skin swelling associated with the HAE attack, where zero indicated no pain or swelling and 100 mm indicated worst possible pain or swelling. Subjects completed the VAS immediately prior to study drug administration, then at 1, 2, 3, 4, approximately 8 \& at 24 hours post-dose. The primary endpoint was the proportion of subject attacks with an improved or stable 3-symptom composite VAS score at 4 hours post dose. The 3-symptom composite was calculated as the average of the VAS scores for abdominal pain, skin pain, and skin swelling. A subject was considered improved or stable if the change from baseline (CFB; time of drug administration) in VAS was ≤ 0.
